The '''OT-7 Patrol Droid''' was a tripedal [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. OT-7 Patrol Droids were among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] deployed in the [[Markaran Plains]] around the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
